import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}nrc-townships`;// Get NRC Townships
const getNRCTownships=async(access_token,params=null)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`},params};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Delete
const deleteNRCTownship=async(nrcTownshipId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+nrcTownshipId,config);return response.data;};const updateNRCTownship=async(nrcTownshipId,nrcTownshipData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+nrcTownshipId,nrcTownshipData,config);return response.data;};// Create
const createNRCTownship=async(nrcTownshipData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,nrcTownshipData,config);return response.data;};const batchDeleteNRCTownships=async(nrcTownshipIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",nrcTownshipIds,config);return response.data;};const nrcTownshipService={getNRCTownships,createNRCTownship,updateNRCTownship,deleteNRCTownship,batchDeleteNRCTownships};export default nrcTownshipService;
